## Correctness — push recipe vs the cited CLAUDE.md form
The canonical CLAUDE.md "Concurrent repo-root committers" form (line 185) is **narrative prose**, not a single `||`-chained command, so "byte-identical" means matching the documented mechanism. The one-liner faithfully composes every documented element:
- `git push origin HEAD:main` — the prescribed form for landing on `main` (CLAUDE.md uses exactly this). ✓
- On rejected push: `git pull --rebase=merges --autostash` then re-push — exactly the documented single-retry recipe. ✓ `--rebase=merges` (load-bearing; plain `--rebase` flattens unpushed merges) and `--autostash` (needed on the always-dirty shared root) both present and correctly spelled.
- Single retry (one `||` branch), **never force-push** — matches the standard; the comment explicitly states "Never force-push" and no `--force` appears anywhere. ✓
The `||`-chained one-liner has no exact precedent elsewhere in `.claude/` (the rest of the repo describes the recipe in prose), but it is a correct, minimal composition of the standard — no novel command path, no wrong arg names, no wrong branch ref form.
